item.title: THE POWER RANKINGS: Westwood remains atop largely frozen Austin Boys rankings
item.description: Our Boys Power Rankings remained nearly as frozen as the Austin weather outside as most teams began the second half of district play. The top 7 squads went a combined 9-1 last week, with #4 Bowie’s close 5-point road loss at #3 Lake Travis being the only blemish of the bunch. That wasn’t enough to cost the Dawgs a spot, however. item.title: THE POWER RANKINGS: 30-win Westlake continues atop Girls Rankings
item.description: Undefeated Westlake cruised to an easy win to become the first Austin-area basketball team – Girls or Boys – to reach the 30-win mark this season and remain Queens of the Hill in the Capital City. Liberty Hill, Glenn and Vandegrift all swept the week to remain in-place behind the Lady Chaparrals. All heck broke loose behind these four, however.Austin High won their won their two games, including an impressive performance against 10th-ranked district foe Dripping Springs, to climb into the Top 5.
